title: Returns & Exchanges Return Shipping Fee by Method
content:
Returns & Exchanges rate card: the return shipping fee withheld on a return whose type withholds the return method fee (on the current schedule, the Standard Return).

## Label fee by return method

| Method the parcel travelled by | Label fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| Mail label | 6.95 |
| Carrier drop-off QR code | 4.95 |
| Scheduled pickup | 9.95 |

The label fee is the method fee register's fee for the return method of the parcel, charged for one label per return.

## Fee withheld

The return shipping fee withheld is the label fee, rounded half up to the cent. A return of a type that does not withhold the return method fee has no return shipping fee withheld.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

| Return | Method of the parcel | Fee withheld |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Return | Carrier drop-off QR code | 4.95 |
| Standard Return | Scheduled pickup | 9.95 |
| Standard Return | Mail label | 6.95 |
| Store Credit Return | Mail label | None (the type does not withhold the method fee) |

The method read is the one recorded on the return for the parcel.
